metadata.title: Algebraic Vector Fields on $S^2$ are $2$-generated
metadata.abstract: We exhibit two vector fields on $S^2$, which generate the entire Lie algebra of algebraic vector fields. Compositions of the flows associated with these two vector fields enable us to approximate every diffeomorphism of $S^2$ isotopic to the identity in the $\mathrm{C}^r$-sense for any $r\geq 0$.
